meta.verification_scope: Official/public sources checked against the values used by the site.
meta.note: Context statistics are not model outputs. Derived percentages are calculated during the build.

tuvalu_resident_population_2022_23.definition: Resident population by region of enumeration, national total
tuvalu_resident_population_2022_23.source: Tuvalu Central Statistics Division, Tuvalu Population and Housing Census 2022-23
tuvalu_resident_population_2022_23.verification_method: Checked against Tuvalu Central Statistics Division 2022-23 Population and Housing Census table.

funafuti_resident_population_2022_23.definition: Resident population by region of enumeration, Funafuti
funafuti_resident_population_2022_23.source: Tuvalu Central Statistics Division, Tuvalu Population and Housing Census 2022-23
funafuti_resident_population_2022_23.verification_method: Checked against Tuvalu Central Statistics Division resident population by region of enumeration.

tuvalu_resident_population_2017.verification_method: Checked against the Tuvalu 2017 Mini-Census reference used for the WorldPop sanity check.

funafuti_resident_population_2017.verification_method: Checked against the Tuvalu 2017 Mini-Census reference used for the WorldPop sanity check.

tuvalu_mean_elevation_msl_m.definition: Mean elevation across all nine islands
tuvalu_mean_elevation_msl_m.source: Wandres et al. (2024), Earth's Future, DOI 10.1029/2023EF003924
tuvalu_mean_elevation_msl_m.verification_method: Checked against Wandres et al. (2024), Earth's Future, DOI 10.1029/2023EF003924.

funafuti_mean_elevation_msl_m.source: Wandres et al. (2024), Earth's Future, DOI 10.1029/2023EF003924
funafuti_mean_elevation_msl_m.verification_method: Checked against Wandres et al. (2024), Earth's Future, DOI 10.1029/2023EF003924.

funafuti_max_elevation_lidar_m.definition: Maximum mapped elevation, Funafuti; the paper notes this local high point is associated with human modification
funafuti_max_elevation_lidar_m.source: Wandres et al. (2024), Earth's Future, DOI 10.1029/2023EF003924
funafuti_max_elevation_lidar_m.verification_method: Checked against Wandres et al. (2024); the paper notes that the local maximum is associated with human-modified ground.

nz_tuvaluan_ethnic_group_2018.verification_method: Checked against Stats NZ Tuvaluan ethnic-group census series.
